name: weighingms
description: WeighingMS - assisted dyestuff weighing station (AI-DLC lab)

scripts.db:update: dotnet ef database update --project src/WeighingMS.Infrastructure --startup-project src/WeighingMS.Infrastructure
scripts.db:migrations:add: dotnet ef migrations add --project src/WeighingMS.Infrastructure --startup-project src/WeighingMS.Infrastructure --output-dir Persistence/Migrations
scripts.api:types: ConnectionStrings__Db=Host=openapi-build-only dotnet build src/WeighingMS.Api -p:OpenApiGenerateDocumentsOnBuild=true && npm run api:types -w web
